text:
harper: opened PR to refresh the quickstart onboarding + hello app. Key goals: move to SDK8 async, unify env var to RW_API_KEY, remove .rw_token pattern, and fix a couple of snippet portability issues. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1786
nilay: thanks — can you call out the exact snippet diffs in the PR description so reviewers know where to focus?
harper: done in the PR: 1) python sync -> async, 2) node top-level await + CommonJS fallback, 3) replace sed -i with cross-platform node/python one-liners, 4) canonicalize curl header to `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`, 5) Dockerfile EXPOSE -> 8080, 6) short ephemeral key example + KMS pointer.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #1786: running build, linkcheck, snippet-tests.
rio: quick catch: curl example still uses lowercase "authorization" in one spot. also Dockerfile EXPOSE was 3000 but the sample app listens on 8080.
harper: fixing both now, will push.
monica: portability nit: please avoid `sed -i` — macOS and some minimal images blow up. Provide both Node and Python replacements and label them "cross-platform".
harper: added both: Node one-liner and a Python heredoc option. Example Node: `node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('config',fs.readFileSync('config.tpl','utf8').replace('PLACEHOLDER',process.env.RW_API_KEY||''))"`
nilay: nice. add a one-line ephemeral-key fetch example so new devs see the shape: `export RW_API_KEY=$(curl -s "https://auth.redwood.local/ephemeral?scope=generate")` and a 1-sentence TTL note.
harper: added ephemeral example and a single-sentence TTL callout. also added a 1-line link to /security/kms for customers who need rotation/HSM.
ci-bot: snippet-tests failed on macos runner: entrypoint.sh triggered a shellcheck warning due to an unguarded var. Log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1786/snippet-log.
monica: fix is to guard with `"${RW_API_KEY:-}"` or `if [ -n "${RW_API_KEY:-}" ]`. also consider adding a brief troubleshooting FAQ: two bullets (missing header vs expired/ephemeral token).
harper: patched entrypoint.sh, added the FAQ, updated the PR. Pushed.
ci-bot: snippet-tests retriggered and passed. Linkcheck flagged a 301 redirect from /integrations/kms -> /security/kms.
rio: update to canonical path and re-run.
harper: updated links to canonical /security/kms. tightened wording on ephemeral keys to one short sentence + example. Pushed final tweak.
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1786. Mergeable.
monica: LGTM from docs UX. I'll sanity-check staging after deploy and run the quickstart locally.
ci-bot: PR #1786 merged to main and site deploy to staging started.
monica: Verified staging: quickstart runs locally, Docker note fixed, ephemeral example works. Left a tiny wording nit on the staging branch for clarity and pushed a micro-fix.
nilay: Approved. Thanks for handling the sed portability and FAQ, that should cut down support tickets.
harper: awesome, thanks everyone :tada: closing thread.
